title: Deep learning algorithm in detecting intracranial hemorrhages on emergency computed tomographies
summary: The study reports additional hemorrhages identified with AI assistance and separately analyzes false positives and false negatives. Results are limited to the evaluated emergency-CT cohort and do not establish prospective clinical outcomes or deployment performance.
ai_technology: A deep-learning algorithm detects intracranial hemorrhage on emergency CT and is evaluated in a retrospective multicenter cohort.
organization: Center for Emergency Training, BG Klinikum Unfallkrankenhaus Berlin, Germany
